title: 飲用水混凝膠凝
summary: 本課以原水特性、瓶杯試驗、混凝與絮體成長為主線，從原水變化與處理目的、瓶杯試驗比較設計、活性成分與投加質量、儲液與計量泵換算進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops raw-water characteristics, jar tests, coagulation and floc growth through ten connected units, beginning with source variability and treatment goals, jar-test comparison design, active ingredient and dosing mass, solution and metering-pump conversion. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 瓶杯試驗比較設計：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Jar-test comparison design: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 瓶杯試驗比較設計 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Jar-test comparison design and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 用同批原水控制混合與沉降時間，只改一項劑量或條件，並量殘濁及溶解有機物。
steps.instructionEn: Use one source-water batch with controlled mixing/settling, vary one dose or condition, and measure residual turbidity and dissolved organics.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：原水濁度=50 NTU；沉降後=5 NTU。模型 ηT=(T0-T)/T0，代入得到 0.9 fraction。適用邊界：濁度指標不是污染物質量或病原去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Raw turbidity=50 NTU; settled turbidity=5 NTU. Model ηT=(T0-T)/T0 gives 0.9 fraction. Applicability: Turbidity reduction is not contaminant mass or pathogen removal.
steps.failure: 同時改藥劑、pH 與時間而宣稱單因素效果。診斷與介入：重做同批原水平行試驗，分開藥量、剪切與時間的影響。
steps.failureEn: Reagent, pH and time are changed together but interpreted as one-factor effects. Diagnostic response: Repeat parallel tests on one water batch, separating dose, shear and time effects.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「瓶杯試驗比較設計」的觀測點。所有杯使用相同攪拌、沉降時間並同時量 pH。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for jar-test comparison design. Use matching mixing/settling times across jars and measure pH. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.title: 快混分散與局部剪切：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Rapid dispersion and local shear: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 快混分散與局部剪切 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Rapid dispersion and local shear and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 快速分散讓水解及電荷中和在適當位置發生；平均 G 不顯示短路與局部極端剪切。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid dispersion places hydrolysis/charge neutralization appropriately; mean G does not reveal bypass or local shear extremes.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：P=100 W；μ=0.001 Pa·s；V=10 m³。模型 G=sqrt(P/(μV))，代入得到 100 s⁻¹。適用邊界：耗散功率平均值，不等於馬達銘牌功率或局部剪切。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: P=100 W; viscosity=0.001 Pa·s; V=10 m³. Model G=sqrt(P/(μV)) gives 100 s⁻¹. Applicability: Mean dissipated power, not nameplate motor power or local shear.
steps.failure: 以平均功率足夠就忽略藥點混合死角。診斷與介入：查實際傳入水中功率、黏度與死角，觀察絮體而非只看電表。
steps.failureEn: Adequate mean power hides dead zones near injection. Diagnostic response: Check power delivered to water, viscosity and dead zones, observing flocs rather than electricity alone.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「快混分散與局部剪切」的觀測點。校正軸功率、黏度與有效槽容，觀察局部絮體破碎。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for rapid dispersion and local shear. Check shaft power, viscosity and effective volume and observe local floc breakage. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

steps.objective: 辨識 殘餘物與驗證報告 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。

steps.instruction: 把水相成分、污泥及庫存列入收支，確認去除是移到殘餘物而非物質消失。
steps.instructionEn: Account for aqueous constituents, sludge and inventory to show that removal transfers material to residuals rather than making it disappear.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：進入=15、出流水=2、排泥=12 kg/d。模型 ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge，代入得到 1 kg/d。適用邊界：殘差可能來自儲存、漏算旁流與量測誤差，不能自動當作反應。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Input=15, effluent=2, sludge=12 kg/d. Model ε=Min-Mwater-Msludge gives 1 kg/d. Applicability: Residual can reflect storage, omitted side streams or measurement error, not automatically a reaction.
steps.failure: 忽略污泥增加與處置需求。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
steps.failureEn: Additional sludge and residual management are omitted. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「殘餘物與驗證報告」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for residuals and verification report. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change.
